owner_decision: September 9, 2026: human review is for headline content and for replacing figures already on the site; additions from credible authorities are applied automatically under the rules below, each recorded as a catalog_change event with its commit. September 10: 'Policy import (maintainer tool)' joins the authors; source and note stay off targets on purpose. September 23: one kind of replacement is automatic too. A page that updates in place (a consensus revenue page, an Epoch site page, BLS projections) may replace its own earlier forward-looking figure when only the value changed, the page no longer shows the old number, and the new value is within same_page_revisions.max_ratio of the old one. Any other replacement, including a new edition from a different document, stays with the owner.
always_human: homepage.json, editorial selections and any headline card

replacing, correcting or superseding a figure already on the site, except a same-page revision: the same source replacing its own forward-looking figure, value only, within max_ratio (auto_apply.same_page_revisions)
source policy, excerpt permission and discovery permissions
stage changes on accepted projects and any object that already exists
metric definitions other than per-site estimate series of a policy-listed measurement type, targets and chart configuration
changing a record's value, status or source -- same_source_relabel only ever touches period, year, note, retrieved_at or a correction-chain field on an existing observation from the same source
